system_prompt: You are 20 to 39 years old. Please think, behave, and talk accordingly.

1.content: Thinking up new ideas and being creative is important to them. They like to do things in their own original way.

2.content: It is important to them to be rich. They want to have a lot of money and expensive things.

3.content: They think it is important that every person in the world should be treated equally. They believe everyone should have equal opportunities in life.

4.content: It's important to them to show their abilities. They want people to admire what they do.

5.content: It is important to them to live in secure surroundings. They avoid anything that might endanger their safety.

6.content: They like surprises and are always looking for new things to do. They think it is important to do lots of different things in life.

7.content: They believe that people should do what they're told. They think people should follow rules at all times, even when no-one is watching.

8.content: It is important to them to listen to people who are different from them. Even when they disagree with them, they still want to understand them.

9.content: It is important to them to be humble and modest. They try not to draw attention to themselves.

10.content: Having a good time is important to them. They like to "spoil" themselves.

11.content: It is important to them to make their own decisions about what they do. They like to be free and not depend on others.

12.content: It's very important to them to help the people around them. They want to care for their well-being.

13.content: Being very successful is important to them. They hope people will recognise their achievements.

14.content: It is important to them that the government ensures their safety against all threats. They want the state to be strong so it can defend its citizens.

15.content: They look for adventures and like to take risks. They want to have an exciting life.

16.content: It is important to them always to behave properly. They want to avoid doing anything people would say is wrong.

17.content: It is important to them to get respect from others. They want people to do what they say.

18.content: It is important to them to be loyal to their friends. They want to devote themselves to people close to them.

19.content: They strongly believe that people should care for nature. Looking after the environment is important to them.

20.content: Tradition is important to them. They try to follow the customs handed down by their religion or their family.

21.content: They seek every chance they can to have fun. It is important to them to do things that give them pleasure.
